comparison.objective: Candidate separates mixed loose bodies with a manual screen; pr-1775 reinstalls a loaded drawer on roller slides and pull-tests its engagement.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual screen grasping, tilting/agitation, selective retention, and support replacement; pr-1775 requires carrying a loaded drawer above hook-clearance height, aligning both runners, closing, releasing, and reopening. Shared bimanual carrying and reseating are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires at least 98% target recovery for completion, both washers retained, both supports engaged, hands clear, and 3 s stability; pr-1775 requires slide engagement, closure with hands off, then 30–80 mm reopening, with load loss or a fall scoring zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Installing and verifying constrained drawer-slide engagement does not test selective particle passage or agitation of loose contents.
